files.description: The registered URL page (ONC certification page for WoundExpert). Contains the EHI Export section describing the b(10) export as a ZIP file with CSV data, images, custom scans, a bundled data dictionary (EHIDataExtract_DataDictionary.xlsx), and ExportSummary.txt. Also contains mandatory disclosures and certification details.

files.description: Full-page screenshot of the registered URL showing the ONC certification page with the EHI Export section visible, captured via Chrome DevTools.

Full-page screenshot of the FHIR API specifications page. Documents the g(10) FHIR API (via Darena Health partnership), NOT the b(10) EHI export. Captured for context to show the two systems are distinct.

2025 Real World Testing Results (11 pages). Reports metrics 3 and 5 only (g(10) FHIR API). The b(10) Data Export metric (metric 8) was dropped mid-year per Executive Order 14192. Shows zero real production customer usage of FHIR API in 2025 — only test usage during Darena Health migration.

files.description: 2026 Real World Testing Plan (18 pages). Contains the most detailed public description of the b(10) EHI export (Measure 8: Electronic Health Record Export). Describes two export modes: Facility Administrator CDA export and Net Health Administrator full EHI export with CSV files and PDF medical records. Covers all 9 measures including b(1)-b(3), b(10), c(1)-c(3), e(1), g(7), g(9), g(10), h(1), and b(11).
